newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Teenage Indonesian groom finds bride is drag queen.
newsitem.headline: Teenage Indonesian groom finds bride is drag queen.

text.p: An Indonesian teenager splashed out on a lavish wedding last weekend only to find when he got home that his bride was a he, not a she.
The Jakarta Post reported on Wednesday a Moslem cleric formalised the wedding at Samarinda in East Kalimantan province.
But it turned out that the bride of the 18-year-old groom was in fact a 38-year-old transvestite drag queen who ran a local beauty parlor, the Post said.
"If this sort of marriage is allowed, it would mean we had set the clock back to the age of pagan ignorance," the newspaper quoted the chief of the local Moslem council as saying.
